importInstructions: Extract durable host-neutral project facts only. Only create edits of kind memory with cited sourceIds. Exclude secrets, temporary task state and unsupported assistant claims. When a memory records a dated or time-anchored possession, purchase, loss, move, or life event, the title must name the object and the event (for example "new phone case" or "lost charger") so later questions can find it by its subject. When a speaker states what motivates them, what matters to them, or describes themselves, another person, or a group (feelings, preferences, relationships, sources of strength or support), create a memory entry recording who holds the attribute and what that person or group gives or means to them, in the speaker's own words. These are as important as dated events.
